input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: photo-editing (flagship 7): read Phase One 16-bit IIQ L (format 8: IQ4 150MP, IQ3 100MP, Trichromatic)
errors: Deleted the first four LibRaw check rows by an over-broad rm of stray files in the samples folder; re-ran them (one extra minute).

Row-cropped IIQ S copies make LibRaw raise LibRawIOError, so the first crop-based develop check failed on five files; wrote tools/iiq_matrix_check.py, which takes only LibRaw's matrix from the unmodified file.
integrity_issues: Nearly concluded the IQ4's file matrix was wrong from a 0.09 mean-colour gap against LibRaw's matrix; a ColorChecker delta E (scene-free) and looking at the render showed the gap measures LibRaw's matrix as much as Phase One's. The refusal was dropped and the eval says neither matrix is ground truth.

doc_friction.issue: Its 0.02 mean-colour gate passes bodies whose matrices disagree by ColorChecker dE 8-12 (neutral test scenes), and earlier evals read a pass as colour agreement; noted in eval/phaseone-iiq-16bit-2026-11-18.md.
SHOOTFLOW_IIQ_SAMPLES must be a folder; the IIQ S eval's wording ('with SHOOTFLOW_IIQ_SAMPLES set to the ten files') reads like a file list, which fails.

goal: Deepen the photo-editing flagship: develop every coded Phase One IIQ format directly.
notes: Format 8 = IIQ L code, values stored unshifted. LibRaw 0.22.2 (rawpy 0.28.0) check: 4 format-8 files, 519,931,264 sensels, 0 differ; IQ4 14-bit and 11 files of 10 other bodies, 0 differ. tests/test_iiq.py: 14 passed, 1 skipped; real-file test passes on the IQ4/Trichromatic folder. Low bits: used evenly; IQ4 read noise 6.0-6.8 16-bit steps, 14-bit rounding would add 1.4-1.8%. Matrix: the file's 0x106 is per sensor family; IQ4 file vs LibRaw ColorChecker mean dE 16 (cyan 58); kept the file's matrix as default. Venture tests: see PR body.
